name: Ruou trai giac
summary: Rượu trái giác is a spirit made from giác fruit, on Cà Mau's list of gifts to carry home.
origin: Cà Mau. It sits with the dried seafood, the pickle, the Thới Bình mắm, and U Minh honey.
where: Sold as a gift in Cà Mau.
seoTitle: Ruou trai giac — Ca Mau fruit spirit
seoDescription: Rượu trái giác is the giác-fruit spirit on Cà Mau's list of gifts to carry home.
